summary: This informational memo describes misbehaviour of some authoritative DNS servers when queried for AAAA records, which hold IPv6 addresses. Such behaviour can block IPv4 communication that should work, cause delays in name resolution, or contribute to denial of service. It documents the problems in detail.

eli5.summary: Some DNS servers get confused when asked for the new style of address and give wrong or no answers. This document lists how they misbehave so people can fix them.

questions: dns servers misbehaving for ipv6 records
